distribution: 云南孟连，海拔一千零二十米。
en: Ancistrotermes menglianensis has an elliptical soldier head widest at the middle and a tongue-shaped labrum with a blunt tip. Each mandible bears a minute marginal tooth near mid-length, one small tooth stands on the inner edge of each basal tooth, and an additional minute point may occur behind the right one. The postmentum is widest centrally and antennae have 16 segments with the fourth shortest. The pronotum is notched in front and nearly straight behind. Minor soldiers are paler but otherwise similar.
soldier: 头椭圆形，中部宽；上唇舌形，端部钝圆；两上颚近中部各有一枚微小缘齿，基齿内缘各有一枚细齿；右上颚的细齿之后，间或另有一枚微尖突；后颏中部最宽。触角十六节，第四节最短。前胸背板前缘中央凹入，后缘近平直。小兵蚁的头部与体色浅于大兵蚁，各部形态均与大兵蚁相似。
